stage_1_results.interpretation: Mechanics and capability are intact. Action-point cost, generic salience, collective framing, and an empty-board system notice are individually and jointly insufficient.

new_audit_evidence.ledger_representation: post_ledger_note is the last of many regular actions
new_audit_evidence.speech_representation: say, whisper, and broadcast also have a dedicated messages array with no item limit
new_audit_evidence.action_slot_saturation: Only 23-39% of voluntary decisions used all four slots, so slot scarcity may contribute but cannot alone explain zero adoption.
new_audit_evidence.positive_control_pattern: Concrete peer-authored role and resource reports populated the ledger; repeated useful notes followed through tick 7.

hypotheses.claim: The ledger is categorized as a costly world action instead of communication, so it is omitted during communication planning.
hypotheses.prediction: A ledger mode in the messages array will outperform an otherwise matched fifth action slot.

hypotheses.claim: A concrete peer example or a single initial institutional owner is required to bootstrap the norm; a generic system notice supplies no useful social proof.
hypotheses.prediction: A single agent-1 bootstrap or realistic peer seed notes will induce later voluntary posts by other agents.

hypotheses.claim: Even after representation is corrected, a one-action-point price suppresses the public-good behavior.
hypotheses.prediction: Free message-channel posting will exceed one-point message-channel posting.

follow_up_rule: Replicate the smallest sufficient non-continuously-mandated intervention in longer Luna and matched Sol worlds.
